correctness.rationale: Directly checked L_e^2=0, L_e^dagger L_e=2|w_e><w_e|, and the common nullspace characterizes phase compatibility. Under compatible phases u is the Laplacian kernel, H u=(a_i+d_i)u_i, and Lindblad dual action on P is (4 gamma/n)Lambda. At stationarity spectral gap yields c q<=2delta sqrt((1-q)q) and hence the upper corridor; trace norm ||L(P)||_1=2delta <= M||P-rho||_1 <= 2 M sqrt(q) yields lower corridor. When delta=0, dissipative inequality integrates for every state and saturates at initial lambda_2 eigenprojector. Independently formed full 3-vertex path Lindbladians and solved stationary trace-one equations for eps=0,.01,.1,.5, verifying positivity, residuals, both bounds; no finite test proves all graphs. Pure and ergotropy claims follow from rank-one dark criterion and positive-hopping Hamiltonian spectral top.
